yuki: quick alert: during Mira v1 int8 bring-up I see detok mismatches concentrated on Canto samples with ZWJ emoji chains. BLEU drop visible.

liang: can you paste one minimal example?

yuki: input: "你話👍‍❤️‍🔥好正"
ref detok: "你話 👍 ❤️ 🔥 好正"
mira-int32 detok: "你話 👍‍❤️‍🔥 好正"
mira-int8 detok: "你話 👍 好正"  (ZWJ collapsed)

kevin: sounds like detok path on int8 fused kernel collapsed grapheme clusters. Any token id diffs?

yuki: int8 detok maps cluster -> single fallback token. Repro: `python ci/evals/run_detok_check.py --model mira_v1 --quant int8 --subset cantonese_emoji --max-samples 200` (int8 mismatches 18/200).

liang: I'll try bypassing the fused detok kernel and run scalar fallback. Adding unit test under ci/testcases/locale/zwj_emoji.txt.

ops-bot: canary deploy queued: mira-v1 int8 (no-fused-detok) -> staging. ETA ~12m.

kevin: also flagging a small RTL bracket mirror case in chat-mode sampling; might share root cause.

ops-bot: canary finished: mismatches reduced to 5/200.

anna: good progress. Liang please open PR with reproducer, test, and scalar fallback. Add model-config toggle to opt-out for affected locales.
